predictions: As with most recent seasons, the amount of stuff that goes into the week 1 newsletter prevents me from having enough space to include both the season-long and the weekly picks. But I still do them both, and then report the week 1 results to you guys here, so that we have a full season of picks. And I very nearly had a great first week… With one match result still to come, I posted a 14-7 record in week 1, with THREE of my seven losses coming in 1001. Dang, so close. I'm also 0.500 or better in all divisions except D so far, so I have my eye on you, D teams… Might not have any idea what you'll do, but my eye is still on you! == Two 1-0 teams ==

Match of the week: (C Div.) Trippin Bulls @ Show Me Your Tips. Wow, only TWO matches of 1-0 teams this week! And this first one is a doozy. Both Trippin and Show Me took out what I think will be high end opponents in week 1, so somebody is about to grab a huge 2-0 start in a race that could get pretty messy. I could see this going either way, but I have a pretty good feeling about Show Me right now, 14-10.

Match #2: (B Div.) Blindsided @ Boom Baby. Both of these teams used doubles comebacks after trailing coming out of singles in week 1 to join Serious in the 1-0 group. Boom was able to get by a pretty tough Outlaws squad and I'm thinking things could go pretty well for them this season, so I'm taking Boom here. It won't be easy, but it's Boom, 14-10. == Two 0-1 Teams ==

Match #3: (E Div.) Y.N.T.A. @ Death Throw. There are also only two matches this week that contain two teams that lost a match last week! And this pair likely thinks they coulda/shoulda won theirs (and I imagine Death Throw is still wondering how the heck they lost with the lead they had). Still feels like a pretty good season could be had by DT though, and they'll figure out how to win a late-match game here. DTs, 15-9.

Match #4: (B Div.) Dysfunctional Outlaws @ Iceman's Ear Defenders. Iceman's presently sits in last after their first match in the RDL, but that loss came at the hands of what I think is the B favorite, and they actually showed out pretty well for themselves. I guess I will go Outlaws (until the full Iceman's lineup all attends at least) in this critical early pair, 14-10. == A 1-0 Team Against A Team Yet To Play A Match ==

Match #5: (E Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Bud Mutha Duckas. The Machine hasn't played yet, and they should be at least a solid E squad, but I think the new-look Ducks are the real deal here. Feels like it could be a while before I'm not feeling the Ducks picks. 15-9.

Match #6: (G Div.) We're Sexy & We Throw It! @ Rippin Darts. I admit that I was expecting a stronger start for my G pick (Rippin), with them losing both cricket sets last week. But a win is a win, and they do sit within a point of the G lead. We Throw It is making their 2023 debut, and this should be interesting, but I'll take Rippin, 16-8.

Match #7: (D Div.) Menace 2 Sobriety @ One Armed Bandits. The Bandits overcame their own DCkt nap to grab a critical win in wk01 over what might well have been one of their top competitors this spring. That bodes pretty well, so I'll stick with the Bandits, 14-10. == Well, ok, one more that is technically two 0-1 Teams ==

Match #8: (G Div.) The Rock Bottoms @ Punk in Drublic. With the Rock Bottoms making the preseason meeting (for the first time ever) and Punk dropping a sad forfeit in week 1, it's Punk alone in the cellar so far. I think they jump back in it a bit here. Punk, 15-9. == And the odd match with TWO(!) 0-0 teams ==

Match #9: (A Div.) Consist. Inconsistent @ The Global Element. With a bye and a postponement, I think this might be the first week 2 match I've ever picked that had BOTH teams with zero matches so far. I have to go with my own guys, of course, so it's Element, 18-6.
